root_cause: The datepicker's `_syncSelectedDates` method writes locale-formatted dates (e.g., "10/22/2026") to input elements, overwriting the ISO-format value ("2026-10-22") needed for form submission. When a user tabs into the date field (triggering datepicker initialization) then presses Escape without selecting a date, the input value is permanently changed from ISO to locale format.
repair_strategy: Modify `_syncSelectedDates` to preserve ISO-format dates in input elements for form submission while still writing locale-formatted dates to display elements. Input elements receive the raw selectedDates[0] value; display elements receive the formatted version.
expected_accessibility_effect: Keyboard users can tab through the date field without altering the saved departure value. The input retains its machine-readable ISO format, ensuring form submission matches the original booking date. Screen readers announce the unchanged date value.
functional_risks: If selectionMode is 'multiple' or 'multiple-ranged', only the first date is written to the input (but the form only expects a single date)
Bound hidden inputs still receive comma-separated ISO dates (unchanged behavior)
Display elements continue to show locale-formatted dates (unchanged)
verification_requirements: Tab to departure field, press Escape, tab to passengers, type 2, submit → departure=2026-10-22&passengers=2
Select a new date via datepicker → input updates to new ISO date
Form submission with unchanged date preserves original ISO format
Display elements (if any) show locale-formatted dates
